about_the_game:
Strip Club Simulator puts you in the owner's chair of the nightlife scene in this comprehensive business simulation. Starting with a small venue, you'll use smart decisions and strategies to transform your club into the city's most popular strip club. As you grow your business, reinvest your earnings to expand your establishment and unlock new stages, services, or content. Experience the thrill of building your own nightclub empire from scratch.

Managing your club means overseeing every detail to maximize fun and profit. Hire the best strip dancers and train them to enhance their performance, rapidly boosting your club's reputation and attracting a steady stream of customers. Organize special themed nights and exclusive parties to captivate VIP guests, elevating your club’s prestige and ensuring unforgettable experiences for your patrons.

Your bar also plays a crucial role in your success. Serve drinks to customers throughout the night to secure a steady income, as the right cocktail menu and prompt service become the keys to a flourishing cash register.

Of course, nightlife isn’t always smooth. Occasionally, unruly patrons who disregard the rules or disturb other guests may appear. In these cases, ensure safety by promptly removing disruptive individuals, preserving both the comfort of your guests and the reputation of your club. With a firm yet fair approach, you'll create an environment where everyone can enjoy themselves safely.

content_descriptors.notes: There is no sexual intercourse whatsoever in the game. Only women in swimsuits are dancing, and there is no nudity beyond that.
